findings.comment: Transformer easements are not shown on the electrical plan, site plan, or any other plan sheets. Width and location of easements required for Austin Energy accessibility are not defined. Plans must depict transformer easement boundaries.

Transformer pad dimensions are not specified on the electrical design plan. No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included in the submitted documents. Applicant must obtain AE Design-approved pad details for the specified service type and show dimensions on the plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad located south-central between Buildings 6 and 7
findings.comment: Transformer pad in south-central location is measured at 4.5 feet from nearest parking/vehicle route, placing it within the 4-foot threshold requiring bollards. No 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) are shown on the electrical plan. Bollards per AE Design pad details must be added to prevent vehicle collision with this transformer.

Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on the electrical plan. The Grading Plan (Sheet 11) does not depict transformer pad locations or drainage flow direction around them. If transformers are oil-filled, grading plan must show drainage slopes directed away from adjacent buildings. Cannot verify compliance without equipment specifications and grading coordination.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from all four transformer locations to meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformers to meters is shown on the electrical plan but does not include dimensioned documentation confirming 100 percent of the routing remains on private property. Plan must include property line dimensions and notes confirming all electrical service line routing from transformer to meter is entirely on private property, not crossing any public right-of-way.

applicableAreas: Tree 4038 (24-inch Live Oak) remaining near transformer in northwest area
findings.comment: Tree 4038 (24-inch Live Oak) is shown to remain on the canopy and root zone impact exhibits near a proposed transformer. No root barrier specifications are provided on the landscape detail sheets or site plans. If tree is within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment) must be shown on the landscape details.

applicableAreas: Transformers 1 and 2 located near western property boundary sidewalks
findings.comment: Transformers 1 and 2 appear adjacent to sidewalks on the western boundary. The minimum 2-foot clearance requirement from the back of sidewalk is not dimensioned on the plans. Distances must be clearly marked from transformer pad edge to sidewalk back of curb.

Fences are shown on the site plan, but clearance distances from transformer pads to fences are not dimensioned. Additionally, transformer pad access door orientation is not specified, making it impossible to verify required clearances (5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for sides without) from removable ventilated obstructions (fences). Plans must indicate access door orientation and fence clearance dimensions.

Transformer hot-stick use area (access door side) requires minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure. Access door location and orientation are not specified on the electrical design plan. Plans must indicate which side is the access door and provide clearance dimensions.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations near retaining walls
findings.comment: Retaining walls are present on the site plan (noted on sheets 11 and 38). Specific distances from transformer pads to retaining walls are not dimensioned. The minimum 5-foot clearance requirement cannot be verified. Plan must show dimensioned clearances from transformer pad edges to all adjacent retaining walls.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to water utility lines
findings.comment: Water utility lines are shown on the site plan and utility tap plan. Specific minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance distances from transformer pads to water lines are not dimensioned. Clearance measurements must be explicitly called out on the plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to wastewater utility lines
findings.comment: Wastewater utility lines are shown on the utility plan. Specific minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance distances from transformer pads to wastewater lines are not dimensioned. Clearance measurements must be explicitly called out on the plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to storm drain lines
findings.comment: Storm drain lines are shown on the storm sewer and utility tap plans. Specific minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance distances from transformer pads to storm lines are not dimensioned. Clearance measurements must be explicitly called out on the plans.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to all underground utilities
findings.comment: Underground utilities (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric) are shown on various plan sheets. Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearances from transformer pads to other underground utilities (excluding gas, fuel, steam) are not dimensioned on the plans. All underground utility separation distances must be explicitly documented.

Cross-section drawings showing vertical clearances in transformer access paths with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas are not provided. The electrical design plan is a plan-view only with no vertical clearance verification. Cross-sections must be provided if any overhead structures or clearance constraints exist above transformer locations.
